items.label: max dead air
items.say: Zero point three seconds. Cut any silence longer than that.

items.label: between visual changes
items.say: Three seconds. Change something on screen at least that often.

items.label: lines of captions max
items.say: Two lines of captions max. More than that and nobody reads.
